name: HANTRU1 Kwajalein / Ebeye cable landing station
developer: Marshall Islands National Telecommunications Authority and HANTRU1 consortium
notes: Telecom edge/cable landing infrastructure, not a commercial hyperscale or colocation data center. Submarine Networks lists HANTRU1 landing points including Kwajalein, Ebeye Island, Majuro, Pohnpei and Guam; NTA describes the HANTRU1 submarine fiber cable as providing international connectivity between the RMI and Guam.

name: IOKWE / Bulikula subsea cable Ebeye landing
developer: Google with Marshall Islands National Telecommunications Authority and Pacific partners
notes: Telecom edge/cable landing infrastructure, not a commercial data center. DCD and SubTel Forum reported that IOKWE will connect Majuro and Ebeye in the Marshall Islands to Google's Bulikula/Halaihai Pacific cable system; public reporting did not give capacity or a completed in-service date.
